evidenceKind: agent QA and independent agent panel; not human research
severityPolicy: Existing panel bands retained; repeated scan nodes are deduplicated. Future unobserved AI/offer questions remain unrated.

findings.job: Discover the collapsed navigation and reach an account destination.
findings.change: Named Open navigation trigger; decorative icon hidden; 44px minimum target.
findings.verificationLimit: Pass02 has no button-name detections; real screen-reader validation remains open.

findings.job: Read navigation, account state and operator recovery/status text.
findings.change: Theme-specific primary/foreground pairs, paper landing accent and scoped light operator login.
findings.verificationLimit: Pass02 retains four routes with color-contrast; shared style instances are not unique defects.

findings.job: Read the overflowing main region using the keyboard.
findings.change: Focusable main region with visible focus outline.
findings.verificationLimit: No pass02 scroll-focusability detection; direct functional keyboard scrolling and human exclusion unproved.

findings.job: Bound unavailable chain information without inferring balance loss.
findings.change: Named chain cards retain honest unavailable-details copy.
findings.verificationLimit: No claim about network failure cause, balances or operational chain transactions; pass02 zoom narration has a stale note.

findings.job: Distinguish never configured from an old saved provider policy.
findings.change: Version-zero built-ins report policy not configured; persisted policy dates retained.
findings.verificationLimit: Read-only replay completed; not evidence of provider readiness or human freshness interpretation.

findings.hypothesis: 52 navigation keys and split verification/provider labels may add effort; all destinations completed.
findings.falsifier: Independent full access and efficient repeated access through available bypass/focus mechanisms.

findings.job: Recover the correct access through the responsible owner.
findings.hypothesis: An interrupted non-deployer may reach the right form yet lack an actionable handoff; existing role-specific links are counterevidence.
findings.falsifier: All five in each segment identify correct authority, safe contact and next action without unrelated credentials.

findings.job: Choose an account or integration control with the intended scope.
findings.hypothesis: Mixed personal/tenant settings and session controls may confuse scope; no mistaken edit was observed.
findings.falsifier: Correct unaided control selection and explanation of account/tenant/browser/global scope.

findings.job: Decide whether to continue when chain details cannot load.
findings.hypothesis: Members may infer total service failure or lost balances; both original agents continued.
findings.falsifier: Accurately bounded outage and safe continuation without coaching; no unsupported balance inference.

findings.job: Read policy freshness and readiness before attempting repair.
findings.hypothesis: Unset/stale/disabled states may still be confused after source correction; no human interpretation collected.
findings.falsifier: All five distinguish untouched defaults, saved updates and disabled state without unnecessary repair intent.

findings.hypothesis: The reader may not know who receives documents or what starting does; submission was not exercised.
findings.falsifier: All five explain recipient, next step and disclosure boundary and can find enough information for their own decision.

findings.job: Explain the product offer before choosing sign-in.
findings.hypothesis: Specialist vocabulary may hinder newcomers; corrected agent sign-in success is not comprehension evidence.
findings.falsifier: All five explain the offer coherently and find ordinary sign-in without costly detours.

findings.job: Understand an AI proposal as an unverified draft with missing jurisdiction facts and no execution.
findings.hypothesis: Future tenant authors may mistake generated drafts/legal-tax warnings for verified advice or execution authority. This surface was not a scored journey in either pass.
findings.falsifier: All five distinguish model consent, uncertain facts, human review, import/save/publish/execute and draft-only boundaries unaided.

findings.job: Read desktop navigation and operator warning controls.
findings.change: Full muted label color; semantic primary; opaque scoped light warning; explicit opaque red/white confirmation normal/dark/hover overrides.
findings.independentStaticReview: recover_session accepted final four-file source diff; no reviewer tests.
findings.verificationLimit: 19 observed instances plus a static-review hidden confirmation state; no post-fix scan or revocation execution.
